scope: Read-only discovery; 17 candidate workflows, not a release-certified total. PA/MD/OTC/close owner workflows are linked rather than recounted.
runtimeStatement: No application/test/database writes or heavy checks were run for this lane discovery. Existing test files and historical browser evidence are not represented as current passes.

crossReferences.scope: Accepted/held receiving, inspection resolution, receipt evidence, purchase returns/reversals own the business workflow; inventory stock kernel is an effect.
Items/brands/categories/units/locations and supplier relationships; IN-007 links only the stock adjustment effect of item stock editing.
Delivery-order reservation/goods issue, sale/refund/void and billing belong to sales/order-to-cash; stock kernel effects are cross-boundary dependencies.
Stopping new work and retained obligations are configuration lifecycle; IN-012 notes pre-admitted count continuation.
Close review/pack use IN-017 as inventory evidence; do not count a second close workflow.

workflows.name: Investigate movement history
workflows.purpose: Trace effective and recorded stock movements, their source and available proof.
authority: inventory.levels.read
Server-derived tenant; history actions enforce inventory read access
transitions: filters → snapshot page → next page / record details / refresh
remaining: Search is retained in URL/client state but omitted from server action filters; verify visible page-search scope and export scope wording.
Recheck current EN/FR, keyboard, stale cursor, empty and query failure behavior in actual application.

workflows.name: Export movement history interactively
workflows.purpose: Obtain an auditable bounded movement-history artifact.
authority: reports.export
inventory.levels.read
Fresh authentication maxAge300 and sensitive export policy
transitions: fresh snapshot → export up to10000 rows → returned content and manifest
sideEffects: Audits access/manifest; returns operational history content
remaining: Hook onSuccess only stores filename/count; no Blob, download link or returned-content consumer was found in the connected workbench.
No inline fresh-auth challenge traced here; expired assurance must have a reachable retry path.
Export excludes cursor and local text search; user-facing scope needs explicit verification.

workflows.name: Prepare, retrieve and expire large history exports
workflows.purpose: Generate large bounded history artifacts through a durable worker and controlled download.
authority: reports.export and inventory.levels.read
Enqueue/download grant require fresh authentication
Download token bound to tenant, actor, expiry and content hash; worker rechecks authority
transitions: enqueue → worker claim/chunks → SENT ready or failure/retry → authorized grant/download → expiry
sideEffects: Encrypted artifact writes/deletes, bounded250000-row export, job/audit evidence
remaining: No production UI caller of enqueue/status/grant actions found.
No HTTP adapter calling streamInventoryHistoryExportDownload found in current app/actions/hooks search.
Worker deployment/schedule, artifact credentials, cleanup and retry runtime remain unverified; no worker executed.

workflows.name: Create a stock transfer draft
workflows.purpose: Request a quantity move between two existing locations.
authority: inventory.stock.transfer
Server actor/org; new-work admission inventory.transfer.create
Current active tenant-owned source/destination/items; inventory-tracked item and available stock
transitions: form → validation → DRAFT; denied/failure stays separate from created
sideEffects: Allocate transfer number and persist draft/audit; no stock movement at creation
remaining: Create draft is not an idempotent command: generated number collision returns conflict, no caller request key.
Duplicate item lines are aggregated for availability checks but persisted separately; verify posting behavior before claiming duplicates supported.
New-work stopped FR denial was browser-tested in prior module run, not rerun in this discovery.

workflows.name: Approve and complete a stock transfer
workflows.purpose: Post both sides of a location transfer using current stock values.
authority: inventory.stock.transfer
DRAFT; active tenant-owned locations/items; sufficient current stock; open accounting period
Separate approver required by service only if either location requiresApproval; UI always excludes creator
transitions: DRAFT → approval command → COMPLETED and moved stock; canonical replay returns recorded event
sideEffects: Paired quantity/value movement in one transaction, optimistic version guards, event/outbox/audit and close invalidation
remaining: Button says Approve Transfer while action immediately completes stock movement; no separately traced dispatch/transit/receipt workflow.
UI eligibility checks creator/status, not explicit permission, while server still enforces permission.
Displayed transfer value uses current item.costPrice; verify whether it is labeled as estimate versus actual posting valuation.
Reproduce duplicate-line, concurrent post, insufficient stock and replay actor cases; tests exist but were not run.

workflows.name: Review transfer status and evidence
workflows.purpose: Inspect draft/completed transfer details and responsible actors.
authority: Route TRANSFERS_READ (existing canonical alias must remain effective)
Read service/action current tenant and inventory read permissions
transitions: list/filter → details → authorized posting in IN-005
sideEffects: Read-only; no separate cancellation/edit/rejection command traced from this screen
remaining: Legacy English labels and portal token scope require actual EN/FR/mobile review.
No connected cancel, reject, dispatch or receive-transfer recovery control found; do not infer those workflows from enum labels.

workflows.name: Request a manual stock adjustment
workflows.purpose: Record a proposed stock correction without directly overwriting on-hand stock.
authority: inventory.levels.adjust or inventory.stock.adjust according to action
Server-derived actor/tenant; inventory.adjustment.create admission
transitions: manual delta/absolute request → DRAFT or manual request SUBMITTED
sideEffects: Captures current quantities/cost and reason; stock posting remains IN-008
remaining: Item master editing belongs to MD; this row owns only adjustment request semantics, not another item-create workflow.
No dedicated adjustment creation/review form found in loss-control; exact item caller full journey remains MD/IN joint verification.
Current signed quantity, cost, evidence and actor rules need focused mutation proof.

workflows.name: Approve and post a stock adjustment
workflows.purpose: Apply an independently reviewed stock correction and expose ledger outcome honestly.
authority: inventory.stock.adjust; enforced inventory write module
Allowed submitted/approved state, evidence and separate approver; open period
Version/quantity guards; frozen count comparisons when count sourced
transitions: eligible adjustment → stock applied + ledger POSTED or BLOCKED → immutable event/replay
sideEffects: Quantity/value update, ledger posting or durable blocker, alert outbox and close invalidation
remaining: No production app/component/hook caller of postStockAdjustmentAction found.
Replay currently returns ledger.status BLOCKED unconditionally at service1174–1178, even when adjustment has a posting batch; needs reproduced correction.
COMPLETED stock state must not imply ledger success. No connected blocked-ledger remediation/retry action traced.

workflows.name: Reverse a posted adjustment
workflows.purpose: Create a compensating stock and ledger correction while retaining original evidence.
authority: Service input requires distinct requester/approver; no authenticated action boundary found
Original tenant-owned COMPLETED adjustment with exactly one fully posted balanced linked journal
No previous reversal/correction-chain reversal; open period and current stock CAS
transitions: original posted adjustment → authorized compensating command → immutable reversal; same-key replay
sideEffects: Reverses quantities/value and original journal; preserves originals
remaining: No current server action or UI caller found.
Distinct caller-supplied actor IDs alone do not establish authenticated approval; a future action must bind identities to real request/review evidence.
Reversal cannot repair a stock-completed/ledger-blocked adjustment; blocked-ledger recovery remains separate.

workflows.name: Freeze a stock-count session
workflows.purpose: Capture the inventory baseline to be physically counted.
authority: inventory.stock.adjust; current tenant/actor; enforced inventory write
inventory.count.create admission; active scoped location/items
sideEffects: Freezes count evidence; no stock movement
remaining: No production UI caller found; loss-control screen is read-only.
No reachable empty-location/item-selection, count-sheet preparation or freeze-again recovery form traced.

workflows.name: Submit physical count results
workflows.purpose: Attach each counted quantity to its frozen baseline and count-sheet evidence.
authority: inventory.stock.adjust; server actor/tenant; enforced inventory write
DRAFT/FROZEN session; every frozen line included; countSheetHash
transitions: FROZEN → submit full counted lines/evidence → SUBMITTED
sideEffects: Persists count evidence and variance; no direct stock posting
remaining: No production UI caller found.
Concurrent submissions and authority binding of evidence need focused verification. Hash confirms content identity, not independent approval.

workflows.name: Review and post a count variance
workflows.purpose: Apply authorized count differences through the adjustment kernel.
authority: inventory.stock.adjust; enforced inventory write
SUBMITTED/APPROVED count; approver distinct from creator and submitter; countSheetHash
Snapshot quantity/version integrity; existing admitted count continuation rules after new-work stop
transitions: submitted count → validated variances → optional adjustment → POSTED; canonical replay
sideEffects: Nonzero variance posts inventory and ledger or explicit blocker; zero-variance count still retains evidence
remaining: No production UI caller found.
Changed frozen stock requires a new count; there is no connected guided refreeze/recount path.
Generated ledger blocker is distinct from posted count status and needs operational follow-up.

workflows.name: Investigate shrinkage and count/adjustment evidence
workflows.purpose: Review inventory loss, count variance and posting completeness.
authority: inventory.levels.read; tenant-scoped read action
remaining: No mutation controls in this workbench; do not label the full count/adjustment workflow interactive.
Existing EN/FR copy and partial/error states are source-reviewed only; current runtime/accessibility not verified here.

workflows.name: Reserve stock manually
workflows.purpose: Record reservation effects against current available stock.
authority: Legacy inventoryActions.reserveInventory requires inventory.levels.adjust and trusted actor/tenant context.
Movement action reserveInventoryMovement only calls getAuthenticatedUser then passes caller organizationId to kernel; no explicit permission or actor-org comparison found.
inventoryAction is error handling, not authorization. Kernel scopes item/location to supplied org, so this does not establish actor access.
transitions: request → reservation effect → owner consumption/release requirement
sideEffects: Reserves available quantity; manual expiresAt captured in metadata
remaining: No direct production reservation UI traced beyond hook; owner-specific delivery reservation belongs to OTC.
Fallback idempotency includes Date.now; identical retry is a new intent unless explicit key used.
Legacy batch uses Promise.all of independent service transactions; partial batch success possible.
No expiry/release worker found; expiresAt metadata alone does not release stock.
Both manual-reservation actions now enforce trusted RBAC tenant/actor and the existing inventory write entitlement. Real action/session and stock-effect integration remain unverified.
Reviewed stop admission is not defined for manual reservations; request-boundary entitlement is not a transaction-level revocation lock.
verificationNotes: 21 failed/5 passed before correction; 69/69 focused and shared tests after. Five source/test files passed lint; full typecheck passed session23336/chunkdf0cab.
The real mutation hook is tested in EN/FR, including unknown-result no-retry. No production UI consumer was located, so this is not a completed manual reservation journey.

workflows.name: Release an unused manual reservation
workflows.purpose: Restore availability when a reservation is no longer needed.
authority: Not operational; no release command with validated source/quantity/actor
remaining: Action explicitly states a service-owned release workflow is required.
Missing source-bound partial/full release and expiry/idempotency path can strand manual reservations.

workflows.name: Compare reconstructed inventory valuation with stored projections
workflows.purpose: Detect unexplained levels and quantity/value/average-cost drift from movement history.
authority: Service input tenant/scope; no authenticated operator endpoint found
transitions: effective+recorded cutoff → deterministic reconstruction → compare current levels
sideEffects: Read-only calculation; function name does not mean it rewrites inventory levels
remaining: No production caller other than barrel re-export found.
No controlled repair command/UI/scheduled monitor traced; do not auto-repair stock.
Historical asOf reconstruction is compared to current levels; interpretation of historical comparison requires review.

workflows.name: Reconcile stock valuation with Class3 ledger and close evidence
workflows.purpose: Expose inventory/ledger mismatch and unposted source evidence to accounting close.
authority: Internal owner services supply tenant and period; close action authority belongs to close lane
transitions: resolve period/currency/cutoff → aggregate opening/movement/closing → mismatch/blocker evidence
sideEffects: Read-only evaluation consumed by close assurance/pack
remaining: No standalone inventory reconciliation remediation UI traced.
Actual account mappings, cutoffs, late-arriving events, currencies and ledger blockers need expert-reviewed fixtures; no accounting certification here.
Close workflow itself must be counted in the accounting lane, not again here.

reservationGatePlan.recommendation: Reuse established inventory write entitlement enforcement on both public manual reservation transports after canonical RBAC and tenant checks; normalize hook failure. Do not expand reviewed stop policy or generic stock kernel.
